svg.title: Glider: blue routing and the first horizontal orange layer
svg.text: Glider: blue, then the first orange layer
Same positions and scale in both views. All visible data connectors are raised outputs.
The glider has one ring of zero cells around it; the central 3 × 3 cells receive orange strips.
Each blue piece repeats its 2 × 2 input in four corner groups.
36 orange strips: four per target cell. Blue padding stays exposed.
Green outline: one target cell’s gathered neighbourhood, enlarged below.
For each input (x, y, y, z):
pack the ones to the left,
This is not the next Life generation: the second orange pass, purple and black/white layers still follow.
